title: Auto, taxi unions to protest bike taxis at Bengaluru Transport Department HQ

ai.summary: Auto and taxi unions in Karnataka plan to besiege Transport Department head offices on Dec 8, opposing legalisation of bike taxis and alleging unfair competition from corporate cab operators, demanding resignation of Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh if demands aren't met by Dec 21.

facts.claim: Twenty auto and taxi drivers’ unions across Karnataka have announced a siege of the Transport Department’s head offices in Shanthinagar on December 8
facts.quote: Twenty auto and taxi drivers’ unions across Karnataka have announced a siege of the Transport Department’s head offices in Shanthinagar on December 8

facts.claim: The protest has been called by the Karnataka App-Based Workers’ Union (KAWU), the Swabhimani Chalakara Trade Union and the Auto Taxi Sanghatanegala Horata Samiti
facts.quote: The protest has been called by the Karnataka App-Based Workers’ Union (KAWU), the Swabhimani Chalakara Trade Union and the Auto Taxi Sanghatanegala Horata Samiti

facts.claim: The unions have also threatened an indefinite statewide protest from December 29 if their demands are not met
facts.quote: The unions have also threatened an indefinite statewide protest from December 29 if their demands are not met

facts.claim: The unions have set December 21 as the deadline for the government to address their demands, failing which they have demanded the resignation of Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh
facts.quote: The unions have set December 21 as the deadline for the government to address their demands, failing which they have demanded the resignation of Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh

facts.claim: Their primary objection is to allowing private white-board two-wheelers to operate as commercial bike taxis
facts.quote: Their primary objection is to allowing private white-board two-wheelers to operate as commercial bike taxis

facts.claim: They argue that commercial auto and cab operators bear the burden of permits, insurance, fitness certificates and taxes, while private vehicles would be allowed to compete without similar obligations
facts.quote: They argue that commercial auto and cab operators bear the burden of permits, insurance, fitness certificates and taxes, while private vehicles would be allowed to compete without similar obligations

facts.claim: The unions have also accused Vietnam-based electric cab company Green SM of undercutting prescribed fares by charging as little as Rs 8 to Rs 10 per km, threatening the livelihood of independent drivers
facts.quote: The unions have also accused Vietnam-based electric cab company Green SM of undercutting prescribed fares by charging as little as Rs 8 to Rs 10 per km, threatening the livelihood of independent drivers

facts.claim: ‘Temporarily halting new vehicle registrations is insufficient; the government must strictly enforce a uniform fare structure to safeguard local drivers,’ the unions said in a statement
facts.quote: ‘Temporarily halting new vehicle registrations is insufficient; the government must strictly enforce a uniform fare structure to safeguard local drivers,’ the unions said in a statement

facts.claim: Other demands include an end to arbitrary commissions charged by ride-aggregator platforms such as Ola, Uber and Rapido, relief from alleged harassment and excessive fines by enforcement agencies, and effective delivery of social security, health insurance and Welfare Board benefits
facts.quote: Other demands include an end to arbitrary commissions charged by ride-aggregator platforms such as Ola, Uber and Rapido, relief from alleged harassment and excessive fines by enforcement agencies, and effective delivery of social security, health insurance and Welfare Board benefits

ai.background_note: Karnataka auto and taxi unions oppose legalisation of bike taxis, claiming it creates unfair competition with corporate cab operators and threatens livelihoods of independent drivers.
